roast.alt: Whole chickens turn on a rotisserie over a grill, with golden-brown crispy skin.

ruins.alt: Weathered stone arches stand in the ruins of an ancient building under a pale sky.

shopkeeper.alt: A smiling older shopkeeper sits in front of his shop window, with shoes and bags hanging above him.

shorts.alt: A woman in a white top and black denim shorts stands on a wooden deck among trees.

sleeves.alt: A man in a cream shirt holds his rolled-up sleeve on a dark background.

snow.alt: Fresh snow covers trees, a wooden fence and the shore of a frozen lake.

sphere.alt: Three glossy white spheres of different sizes sit on a red surface in a beam of light.

spicy.alt: A big pile of long green chilli peppers fills the frame.

sprinkle.alt: Coarse salt falls from above onto a raw piece of beef next to rosemary.

steam.alt: Steam rises from stacked bamboo steamers on a kitchen counter.

storm.alt: Dark grey storm clouds fill the sky.

suburb.alt: A row of similar houses stands behind a grass strip and a pond that reflects them.

subway.alt: A blurred train passes a dim station platform where a few people sit and walk.
